title: Dia 1, dia 7, dia 30 usando KizuBot
concept: A tear-off desk calendar in the vlog frame: three pages fan in on the beat (DIA 1 / DIA 7 / DIA 30), then each page tears off with a shutter to reveal a real customer print for that stage — setting up with support ('Até parece que sei programar'), 'fechou 7 dias usando o kizubot né?' → 'Bot joga muito kkk', and '600kkzin pra conta' (no primeiro mês) → a 0→600kk count-up.
claims: o suporte te ajuda a configurar

youtube.description: Dia 1: 'Até parece que sei programar'. Dia 7: 'fechou 7 dias usando o kizubot né?' — 'Bot joga muito kkk'. Dia 30: '600kkzin pra conta' no primeiro mês (dinheiro do jogo). Prints reais de clientes diferentes; o suporte te ajuda a configurar. kizubot.com

notes: DIA 1 = parece-que-sei-programar (customer setting up a rule with the owner's guidance; note 'configurando'); DIA 7 = bot-joga-muito (owner's 'fechou 7 dias usando o kizubot né?' + customer's 'Bot joga muito kkk', both highlighted); DIA 30 = primeiro-mes-600kk--600kk ('600kkzin pra conta') with the handwritten caption 'no primeiro mês' — the full print isn't shown because its first line names the legacy plan 'vip2' (orchestrator instruction). 600kk is in-game currency, counted up 0→600 with no money visuals. The calendar pages carry a small 'KizuBot™ | kizubot.com' footer as the early brand cue.
